title: Make our store readable and buyable by AI agents before holiday peak
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ); Walmart opened to outside shopping agents with spending limits; Amazon widened Shop Direct to keep agents out; Apple showed touchscreen laptops; memory costs stay high to 2028.

points.headline: Retailers are setting the rules for AI shopping agents
points.detail: Walmart added agent profiles, terms and shopper spending limits while Amazon expanded Shop Direct to hold discovery in-house. We should decide how agents read and buy from our store.

points.headline: AI is now a mainstream discovery channel, and shoppers favour marketplaces
points.detail: 55% of consumers use AI during discovery (NIQ), and shoppers would send agents to marketplaces over brand sites. Our product data and marketplace listings must both be agent-ready.

points.headline: Apple goes touchscreen while memory costs keep PC prices under pressure
points.detail: Apple showed pricey touchscreen laptops; Samsung sees no memory price relief before 2028. We should review premium positioning, touch lines and pricing plans.

points.headline: Memory fears raise appetite for flexible PC financing; Walmart lengthens deals
points.detail: IDC surveys financing interest among PC buyers; Walmart stretches Black Friday/Cyber Monday to 14 days. We should test leasing and instalments and review our deal calendar.
